title: 3 Red Flags of a Crypto Scam Every Beginner Should Know
caption: Scams cost crypto users billions every year. Learn the three warning signs that show up again and again.

scenes.head: WOULD YOU SPOT A SCAM?
scenes.narration: Crypto scams cost people billions of dollars every year. Here are three red flags every beginner should know.

scenes.head: RED FLAG ONE
scenes.narration: Red flag one: guaranteed returns. No real investment is risk free. Anyone promising to double your coins is lying.

scenes.head: RED FLAG TWO
scenes.narration: Red flag two: pressure. Scammers push you to act right now, so you do not stop to think or ask anyone.

scenes.head: RED FLAG THREE
scenes.narration: Red flag three: asking for your seed phrase or private keys. No real company or support agent ever needs them.

scenes.head: WHERE IT HAPPENS
scenes.narration: Scams often start with a message from a stranger, a fake giveaway, or a copycat website. Always check the web address.

scenes.head: BEFORE YOU SEND
scenes.narration: Before you send anything, check the website, ask who really gains, and wait a day. Real opportunities will still be there.
